g.text: REFA, REFB to the 3.5 mm sleeve through its net tie

g.desc: REFA, REFB to the 3.5 mm sleeve through its net tie

g.text: 1. Function: Cirrus Logic CS43198 for the left channel in mono mode (dual mono, BOM v1

g.desc: 1. Function: Cirrus Logic CS43198 for the left channel in mono mode (dual mono, BOM v1

g.text: line 18): AOUTA and AOUTB a differential pair into both output stages; I2C2 address 0x30 (ADR to ground).

g.desc: line 18): AOUTA and AOUTB a differential pair into both output stages; I2C2 address 0x30 (ADR to ground).

g.text: 2. Absent state: never omitted (T1-040). RESET held low by the host-side pull-down; INT pulled

g.desc: 2. Absent state: never omitted (T1-040). RESET held low by the host-side pull-down; INT pulled

g.text: up only on DAC_DIG_1V8; I2C isolated while DAC_DIG_1V8 is off (G2).

g.desc: up only on DAC_DIG_1V8; I2C isolated while DAC_DIG_1V8 is off (G2).

g.text: 3. Clock master: SCLK1 and LRCK1 drive I2S_BCLK and I2S_LRCK through 22 Ω (HDG p. 70).

g.desc: 3. Clock master: SCLK1 and LRCK1 drive I2S_BCLK and I2S_LRCK through 22 Ω (HDG p. 70).

g.text: XTI/MCLK from its own divider (blk.mclk); XTO, CLKOUT, TSO and DSDB/LRCK2 unused.

g.desc: XTI/MCLK from its own divider (blk.mclk); XTO, CLKOUT, TSO and DSDB/LRCK2 unused.

g.text: DSD: DSDA from DSD_x, DSDCLK from I2S_BCLK (native DSD reserved, blackbird-os ADR 0006).

g.desc: DSD: DSDA from DSD_x, DSDCLK from I2S_BCLK (native DSD reserved, blackbird-os ADR 0006).

g.text: 4. HP_DETECT tied low: plug detection is on the jacks (expander P10, P11).

g.desc: 4. HP_DETECT tied low: plug detection is on the jacks (expander P10, P11).

g.text: 5. VA from its own TPS7A2018 (EN = AUDIO_LN_EN) behind link L1; VL, VD, VCP on DAC_DIG_1V8;

g.desc: 5. VA from its own TPS7A2018 (EN = AUDIO_LN_EN) behind link L1; VL, VD, VCP on DAC_DIG_1V8;

g.text: VP on DAC_VP (PCB-A-05). GNDA, GNDCP, GNDD and the pad in one ground (PCB-A-01, -02).

g.desc: VP on DAC_VP (PCB-A-05). GNDA, GNDCP, GNDD and the pad in one ground (PCB-A-01, -02).

g.text: 6. Open: series values other than 0 Ω (bring-up, G2); CS43198 pins fail-safe unpowered (UNVERIFIED).

g.desc: 6. Open: series values other than 0 Ω (bring-up, G2); CS43198 pins fail-safe unpowered (UNVERIFIED).
